import argparse
import inspect
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import ModuleType

sys.path.insert(0, '/private/tmp/nanogpt-macbook-build/scripts')
import compare_sampling
from nanogpt_macbook import engine
from nanogpt_macbook.benchmark import source_info
from nanogpt_macbook.config import PRESETS

args = argparse.Namespace(pairs=10,tokens=200,temperature=0.8,top_k=40,seed=42,out=Path('/private/tmp/ngpt-window-queue-sweep-8ae57bc.json'))
assert not args.out.exists()
engine.select_device('gpu',2)
reference,info=compare_sampling.reference_modules('7f741e3')
record=dict(source=source_info(),reference=info,method=dict(pairs=10,device='gpu',generated_bytes=200,temperature=0.8,top_k=40,sampling_seed=42,weight_seed=1337,queue_intervals=[1,2,4],timed_work='complete generation after weights load, alternating fresh models, one process, kernel caches shared'),prototype_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),results=[])
for queue in [1,2,4]:
    module = ModuleType('queued_engine')
    module.__dict__.update(engine.__dict__)
    source=inspect.getsource(engine._sample_window).replace('index % 8','index % '+str(queue)).replace('generated[-8]','generated[-'+str(queue)+']')
    exec(compile(source,__file__,'exec'),module.__dict__)
    exec(compile(inspect.getsource(engine.generate),__file__,'exec'),module.__dict__)
    compare_sampling.engine=module
    for preset,(config,_) in PRESETS.items():
        prompt=('After the rain, Mira opened the window. '*20)[:config.context]
        compare_sampling.compare(config,preset,prompt,args,reference,record)
        record['results'][-1]['queue_interval']=queue
        args.out.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('Completed queue interval',queue,flush=True)
